item.name: Auth
item.description:
Email/password auth (Better Auth + bearer plugin). Send the returned `data.token` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Rate limits (shared across instances via Redis): login, register and change-password allow 20 FAILED attempts per 15 min per IP.
Only these Better Auth endpoints are reachable: get-session, change-password, revoke-sessions, revoke-other-sessions, ok.
Everything else under /auth (e.g. list-sessions, verify-password, social sign-in) returns our 404 envelope.

item.name: Pricing
item.description:
Price (BDT) = baseFee + ceil(max(0, weight - baseWeightKg)) × perKgFee, i.e. extra weight is charged per started kg.
Rule lookup: active rule for (serviceType, originZone, destinationZone), else the service's default rule (both zones null).
No rule → 422. Weight above the rule's maxWeightKg → 422. Money fields are strings (Decimal).

item.name: Shipments
item.description:
All routes need a Bearer token. Scope: CUSTOMER sees own shipments, COURIER sees assigned ones, ADMIN sees all.
Shipments outside your scope return 404 (not 403) so ids can't be probed.
Price is always calculated on the server; sending price/status/trackingId returns 400.
Workflow: pickup (customer) → assign (admin) → PATCH /status (courier/admin, see each request) → DELIVERED or RETURNED.
